svg.title: The search before its providers have come
svg.desc: The search asks Nextcloud for its providers and its contacts when it first opens on a page, at once when a button opens it, with the first key in the field of Nextcloud 35. Nextcloud searches 300 milliseconds after the last key. When both answers have come by then, it searches. When they haven't, on a busy server, Nextcloud 35 searches once they come, while Nextcloud 33 and 34 search nothing, not even Files, and don't try again. So where a button opens the search, openSearch of ui.mjs waits for both answers before anything is typed, and flow.mjs holds the answer with the providers back for three seconds, so that a step that doesn't wait fails in every run.
